title: Wednesday 21 October: France, Barclays, Nordics
desc: French spreads widen ahead of Friday's Moody's review, the Bank of England probes Barclays' private credit swaps, and Nordic supervisors tighten on bank models.

title: Tuesday 20 October: French spreads, Nordic model add-ons
desc: French bank stress as the OAT-Bund spread nears 142bp ahead of Moody's on Friday; FI's temporary capital add-on on SEB and Nordea's buyback pause; UniCredit gets ECB approval to take control of Commerzbank.

title: Monday 19 October: S E B add-on, Commerzbank, A I credit
desc: The Swedish regulator adds about ten billion kronor to S E B's capital requirement, the E C B clears UniCredit to take control of Commerzbank, and CoreWeave's distressed bonds raise A I credit worries as Brent hits one hundred and ten dollars.

title: Sunday 18 October: UniCredit Clears Commerzbank
desc: The ECB lets UniCredit pass 30% of Commerzbank, Swedish regulator adds a capital add-on at SEB while Nordea pauses buybacks, and French debt and CoreWeave's bonds stress European banks and AI financing.

title: Saturday 17 October: US banks' losing streak
desc: US bank stocks on their longest weekly losing streak since 2008 despite clean regional results, the AI debt scare spreads from CoreWeave to Asia and Jakarta, and Brent hits 110 dollars ahead of the Fed.

title: Friday 16 October: Nordea pauses buybacks
desc: Nordea pauses buybacks on tougher ECB model rules, the ECB clears UniCredit to take control of Commerzbank, and US Bancorp and PNC report as hot PPI and an AI credit scare hit markets.

title: Thursday 15 October: Nordea pauses buybacks, AI debt hits Asia
desc: Nordea buyback pause on ECB model review and the SEB read-across, Kospi and Nikkei sell-off on AI debt fears, hot US PPI but falling yields, US regional banks, Iambic IPO, and 15 October 2008.
